_readme: An example config for this trade. Copy it over engine.config.json and edit. Prices are in cents: 8900 is $89.00. A service with "due": 0 takes no payment and becomes a visit request instead. This file is served to the browser, so put nothing private in it; the inbox that receives bookings is the NOTIFY_TO environment variable, not this file.

copy.headline: Book a roofer.
copy.sub: Tell us what's going on, pick a time, and hold your spot. Two minutes, and nothing is charged until you confirm.
copy.depositNote: The deposit comes off your bill. If we can't make it, you get it back in full.

services.name: Active leak
services.blurb: Water coming in now. We find it, tarp it, and tell you what it needs.
services.label: Leak visit and tarp
services.note: Covers the visit, the find and a temporary cover. The repair is quoted before we start.

services.name: Roof inspection
services.blurb: Before you buy, after a storm, or because it's been a while. A written report with photos.
services.label: Inspection with report
services.note: Paid in full up front. Comes off the price if we do the work.

services.name: Repair
services.blurb: A few shingles, flashing, a vent boot, a soft spot.
services.label: Repair visit
services.note: A $100 deposit holds the day; the balance is due when it's done. Bigger than it looked: we stop and quote.

services.name: Gutter clean-out
services.label: Gutter clean-out, whole house
services.note: Paid in full up front. Guards and repairs quoted on the day.

services.name: Full replacement
services.blurb: An estimate on paper, free, with material options and prices.
services.label: Free on-site estimate
services.note: Nothing to pay now. We'll confirm the time by phone.

urgency.label: Today — it's leaking
urgency.note: Same-day and after-hours visits carry a fee, shown before you pay.
